request.goal: route_coverage is called with list(RunConfig(worker_family="claude").worker_routes()) and checker=(config.checker_model, config.checker_effort), as the frontier_providers CLI does. What value does the report give for "required" (len(needed))?

pass: 9: eight worker routes (sonnet and opus at low, medium, high, xhigh) plus the checker. The short route is already one of the worker routes; the docstring is not a separate entry.
fail: 10: eight routes, the checker and the short route.
With 9 candidate entries, the short route counts twice, so required is 10.
